Numeric7 stays7; executable fail-closed repair, not runtime restoration. R2 append partial-output clarification. L1 canonical planner.
# Contract
Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. All item paths absolute under this root. Write only assigned file and own report; NEVER edit old receipts/lessons or fleet/sibling files. No commits, tests/builds/linters/formatters/smoke runs: L1 verifies once after edits. Leaf; no delegation/background jobs. Send concerns only agent://KamaR15, never orchestrator/all. No ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files; never history/session access or separate omp CLI. No service restart or host mutation.
Tooling authorization: may install/upgrade helpful tools only after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; record tool/version/channel/reason. Pacman guard: before any install dry-run pacman -Sp --print-format '%n %v' <pkgs>; proceed only if every listed package is not installed (pacman -Q fails); no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade or host-service restart. Prefer no installs here.
# Falsification wave
Wave1 built actual guard and matrix. Attack only final committed candidates under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; no editing except your own report. No gate/test execution: L1 executes after all owners finish. Reading and plain metadata counts permitted. Re-open named source where assigned. Focus items independent. The guard ONLY adds len(declared)!=unique rejection with existing stripped names. Matrix uses real classifier plus runner audit and classifier markers. Fail findings require concrete source/fixture evidence, not speculative scope expansion. No outside non-author admission authority.

Operator host-safety ruling effective now: ALL pacman transactions paused host-wide pending host recovery decision; no pacman installs even if dry-run would pass. Other authorized official channels remain allowed with version/channel/reason record.
